comments.value: Kind of like how PSHome did where it downloaded a place first before you could go in?

Wouldn't it be nice to have a 'Load in background' option in the client and also a slider for a bandwidth limit in the system menu? The yellow logo could pop up when the download has finished. 
Nice to have if you want to explore a few new worlds in one big run. Saves a lot of time on slow connections. Once you enter an interesting new place you select your next destination before you start to explore the world you're in. Once its done downloading you can switch to another world in seconds instead of up to a few minutes. Another nice thing is that nobody has to wait for a few minutes(in the worst case) for his friends on the other end of a portal.

EDIT: Maybe I could put this in as a separate request...?

author.name: Vtuber めかにゃんこ🥕🐬😸(meka nyanko)

comments.value:
I agree.
I have a slow internet connection, and unfortunately, if I use VRCHAT during that time, I may have to wait 5 to 10 minutes on the World Road.
I think it's impossible to save all the world data. However, I am convinced that time can be used more effectively when it becomes possible to download and update only the world with friends or the world that has been set in advance.
Closing due to age, please make a new post if it is still relevant.

details: For lower bandwidth users, loading worlds they haven't already visited can take a significant amount of time. But to my knowledge the only way to download worlds currently is to visit them from within the client. If a webpage or some other solution that allowed for a user to download the world before hand was available it could greatly reduce in game downtime from having to wait in the loading screen.
title: Download worlds outside of client
